catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results: net income $11.7M ($0.19/diluted share, $0.23 adjusted) vs a net loss of $39.9M (-$0.76/share) a year earlier; revenue ~$271.2M, beating a ~$247.2M consensus; return to YoY sales growth for the first time in four years; raised full-year 2026 guidance to $980M-$990M in sales and 5.5%-6.5% adjusted operating margin
catalysts.impact: Return to GAAP profitability after a string of losses; premarket move reported between +16.9% and +25.7% across aggregators; ~$10M of wholesale shipments were reportedly pulled forward from Q4 into Q3
